description: FRF-WP03 AC binding payload contract (define-acceptance-contract desk). One atomic acceptance criterion binding. bindsTo carries BOTH UC citation shapes the reverse grammar requires: the scenario-level binding (edge/0051) and the terminal-branch binding (edge/0052) - a scenario-facing AC must retain both (stripping either is a killed mutation). Every criterion binds exact FR or NFR material (edges 0049/0050; RULE is not an AC-bindable kind). Evidence kind is the closed four-value vocabulary and an observable terminal result is declared (cr-05). AC remains WHAT-side: architecture/file-allocation keys are typed SCOPE_VIOLATION. Payload contract only.

requirementRefs.description: Exact FR or NFR member ids this criterion verifies (min 1).

ucScenarioRefs.description: Scenario-level UC citation (edge/0051); required together with ucTerminalBranchRefs for a scenario-facing criterion.

ucTerminalBranchRefs.description: Terminal-branch UC citation (edge/0052); required together with ucScenarioRefs for a scenario-facing criterion.

evidence.description: The evidence method and observable terminal result (cr-05: evidence type and observable terminal result are declared).

observableTerminalResult.description: The observable terminal result this criterion verifies end to end.

verifiableStatementRefs.description: References to the verifiable statement (given/when/then) of this criterion; resolved against the exact accepted verifiable-statement id set.

title: FRF AC binding (frf-contracts.ac-binding.v1)
